newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Farm Credit sets rates on $2.025 bln bonds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Farm Credit sets rates on $2.025 bln bonds.

text.p: The Federal Farm Credit Bank Funding Corp said Tuesday it set interest rates on two issues of Federal Farm Credit Banks Consolidated Systemwide Bonds totaling $2.025 billion. The issues will be dated and delivered September 3, 1996.
The first issue is for $1.685 billion with an interest rate of 5.34 percent and a spread of +14. It matures on December 2, 1996 and carries a concession of $0.20 per $1,000.
The second issue is for $340 million with an interest rate of 5.43 percent with a spread of +7. It matures on March 3, 1997 and carries a concession of $0.30 per $1,000.
